metadata.title: Primary-evidence follow-up: health designations and ministries, the health department 1893-1977, PHSA registry identities, sheriffs, ferries and housing

conventions.date_precision: kept as stated by the source; a year is never 1 January

events.title: M597/1995 designates a set of twenty regional health boards, repealing their individual regulations

evidence.locator: M597/1995, made 6 December 1995 (Reg. 521/95)

events.interpretation_notes: The order-made day. The boards' earlier individual designations keep their own dates; nine rural boards of this set were not continued in 1997.

events.title: Health Authorities Amendment Act, 1997: councils' regional-service budgets go straight to the minister, councils stop reporting to boards, and the minister approves bylaws

evidence.locator: Health Authorities Amendment Act, 1997, SBC1997 c.23, original chapter

events.interpretation_notes: Councils and boards answered to the minister throughout; this changes the line between council and board, not the ministry.

events.title: Health authorities deliver child and youth programs (public-health nursing, child and youth mental health, infant development) under the Ministry for Children and Families' policy direction

evidence.locator: Auditor General 1998 review, printed pp. 1 and 33-34

events.interpretation_notes: Observed in the April-July 1997 review; it does not say which of the 52 bodies delivered each program.

events.title: Health becomes Health Services, which keeps the Health Authorities Act; Health Planning takes strategic planning, policy, resource allocation, capital planning and evaluation

evidence.locator: OIC 565/2001, Appendix A ss. 37-43; Schedule B ss. 11-12

events.interpretation_notes: A split of functions: the authorities answered to Health Services, with Health Planning setting system policy beside it.

events.title: The seven community health services societies' governors replaced by the new authorities' appointees (M298-M305/2001)

evidence.locator: M298/2001 to M305/2001, single-page orders

events.interpretation_notes: Appointments only: not a dissolution, a conveyance of assets or an amalgamation.

events.title: The seven community health services societies dissolved, as the corporate registry records

evidence.locator: OrgBook BC: Conversion Society Dissolution (Event:CONVSDIS) for S0036593-S0036599

events.interpretation_notes: How and to whom their assets passed is not found.

events.title: Health Act provides for a Provincial Board of Health and local boards of health

evidence.locator: Health Act,1893, SBC1893 c15

events.interpretation_notes: An antecedent of the provincial health function, not the start of the department.

events.title: A Social Welfare Section in the Provincial Secretary's department

evidence.locator: OIC1294/1934 — Social Welfare Section appointment

events.interpretation_notes: Known by this day (an appointment to it took effect 12 November 1934); not its creation.

events.title: The Department of Health and Welfare Act comes into force

evidence.locator: OIC 2060/1946, approved 10 September 1946; proclaimed in the British Columbia Gazette, 3 October 1946, p. 2905

events.interpretation_notes: Assented 11 April 1946; proclamation authorized 10 September; published 3 October.

events.title: Order transferring listed health and welfare functions from the Provincial Secretary to the new department

evidence.locator: OIC 2214/1946 — assignment of functions to Health and Welfare

events.interpretation_notes: The order's approval; when each transfer took effect is not separately recovered.

events.title: Physiotherapists and Massage Practitioners Act and Welfare Institutions Licensing Act duties return to the Provincial Secretary

evidence.locator: OIC 752/1947 — two functions reassigned to Provincial Secretary

events.title: Health and Welfare splits into Health Services and Hospital Insurance and Social Welfare, both in force
events.interpretation_notes: The same day Provincial Secretary mental-health responsibilities moved to Health Services and Hospital Insurance.

events.title: Renamed the Department of Health by statute

evidence.locator: Department of Health Services and Hospital Insurance Amendment Act, SBC1973 c109

events.interpretation_notes: The statute's date; its commencement is not separately recovered.

events.title: Ministerial Titles Act amends the Department of Health Act to the Ministry of Health Act

evidence.locator: Ministerial Titles Amendment Act, 1977, SBC 1977 c.75

events.interpretation_notes: Assent. Proclamation was authorized on 21 October 1977; the proclamation itself is not retrieved. The ministry had been named by OIC 3199/1976 a year before.

events.title: PHSA and five branch societies (cancer, disease control, mental health, transplant, Children's and Women's) amalgamate as one society (S0069120)

evidence.locator: Registrar notice, 1 April 2018 entry

events.title: PHSA and BC Clinical and Support Services Society amalgamate (S0069572)

evidence.locator: Registrar notice, 29 June 2018 entry

events.interpretation_notes: Predecessors S0069120 and S0054278.

events.title: Cancer Control Agency of British Columbia registered as a society (S0011125)

evidence.locator: BC Corporate Registry credential history

events.interpretation_notes: The society's registration, before the 31 October 1974 provincial takeover of cancer care.

events.title: The registry records the society's new name, British Columbia Cancer Agency

evidence.locator: BC Corporate Registry credential history

events.interpretation_notes: The day for the 1990 rename already recorded by year.

events.title: British Columbia Transplant Society registered (S0021154)

evidence.locator: BC Corporate Registry credential history

events.title: British Columbia Mental Health Society registered (S0023123), to operate Riverview

evidence.locator: BC Corporate Registry credential history

events.title: Children's and Women's Health Centre of British Columbia formed by amalgamation (S0037131)

evidence.locator: BC Corporate Registry credential history

events.interpretation_notes: Which societies were its parties is not recovered.

events.title: British Columbia Centre for Disease Control Society registered (S0037212)

evidence.locator: BC Corporate Registry credential history

events.title: British Columbia Centre for Disease Control and Prevention Society formed by amalgamation (S0042940)

evidence.locator: BC Corporate Registry credential history

events.interpretation_notes: The 1997 society (S0037212) and a January 2001 society of the same new name (S0042656) end that day; the full list of parties is not recovered.

events.title: Nine sheriffs, one for each bailiwick: the counties of Westminster, Cariboo (outside the Peace River districts), Kootenay, Victoria, Nanaimo, Yale, Vancouver and Prince Rupert, and the Peace River portion of Cariboo

evidence.locator: Printed p. 2616, middle column; PDF page 14. Notice dated 21 February 1972, published 5 July 1973.

events.interpretation_notes: A Gazette roster (notice dated 21 February 1972): the offices as they stood before the 1974 reorganization, not the days they were established.

events.title: Statute Law Amendment Act, 1974 gives sheriffs province-wide jurisdiction
events.interpretation_notes: The jurisdictional statute; the administrative amalgamation of the nine offices is dated only to 1974.

events.title: B.C. Ferry Authority established under the Coastal Ferry Act, as the sole voting shareholder of the company the corporation became

evidence.locator: Coastal Ferry Act, SBC 2003 c. 14, ss. 2 and 89

events.interpretation_notes: Not the British Columbia Ferry Authority of 1964 (the renamed Toll Highways and Bridges Authority).

events.title: Ministerial responsibility for BC Housing and PRHC moves from Employment and Investment to Social Development and Economic Security

evidence.locator: Printed p. 60 (PDF p. 55) for Province acquisition in 1973; printed p. 35 (PDF p. 30) for 21 July 1999 ministry reassignment; pp. 24–25 and 59–62 for separate governance.

events.title: OIC 3199/1976 names the Department of the Provincial Secretary the Ministry of the Provincial Secretary and Travel Industry

evidence.locator: Two-page order; approval stamp 28 October 1976 and complete operative list

events.interpretation_notes: An executive naming order: it does not by itself move assets or functions. The statutory titles followed in 1977.

events.title: Homeowner Protection Office opens

evidence.locator: Printed p. 3, PDF p. 7.

events.interpretation_notes: The opening, after its legal establishment on 21 September.

events.title: Pemco Holdings Ltd. incorporated (No. 52129)

evidence.locator: Printed p. 2290, right column, No. 52129; PDF p. 50.

events.interpretation_notes: A private company; the incorporation certificate itself is not obtained.

events.title: The Province acquires Pemco Holdings Ltd.

evidence.locator: Printed p. 60 (PDF p. 55) for Province acquisition in 1973; printed p. 35 (PDF p. 30) for 21 July 1999 ministry reassignment; pp. 24–25 and 59–62 for separate governance.

events.interpretation_notes: The day and instrument are not found.

events.title: BC Housing gains control of PRHC through governance and board-appointment changes

evidence.locator: Financial statements note 1, printed p. 10/PDF p. 43; note 20, printed pp. 23–24/PDF pp. 56–57.

events.interpretation_notes: Control, not a share transfer. BC Housing consolidated PRHC in its accounts from 31 March 2024.
